entries.reason: The engineering broker (only with -c engineeringAgents=true) installs its own copy of voc-datalake/lambda/layers/signing-deps for cryptography; since 7.62.00 that directory also pins pypdf, the projects API's Documents Library reader (shared/library_extract.py), which the broker never imports. One requirements file per layer directory, and VocApiStack has no room for a layer of its own (api-engagement-budget.test.ts).
